name: peerhop-root
description: Root package for PeerHop build scripts

scripts.prebuild:frontend: cd ui/frontend && npm run build && cd ../.. && rm -rf pkg/server/dist && cp -r ui/frontend/dist pkg/server/dist
scripts.build:win:nsis: npm run prebuild:frontend && cd ui && wails build -clean -platform windows/amd64 -nsis -o ../../../builds/peerhop_setup.exe
scripts.build:win:msi: npm run prebuild:frontend && cd ui && wails build -clean -platform windows/amd64 && cd build/windows/msi && wix build product.wxs -ext WixToolset.UI.wixext -o ../../../../builds/peerhop_setup.msi
scripts.build:linux: npm run prebuild:frontend && cd ui && wails build -clean -platform linux/amd64 -o ../../../builds/peerhop_linux
scripts.check:release: powershell -Command "$files = @('builds/peerhop_win.exe', 'builds/peerhop_setup.msi', 'builds/peerhop_linux', 'builds/peerhop_cli_win.exe', 'builds/peerhop_cli_linux'); $missing = @(); foreach ($f in $files) { if (Test-Path $f) { Write-Host \"✓ Found: $f\" -ForegroundColor Green } else { $missing += $f; Write-Host \"✗ Missing: $f\" -ForegroundColor Red } }; if ($missing.Count -gt 0) { Write-Host \"`n✗ Missing $($missing.Count) file(s)!\" -ForegroundColor Red; exit 1 } else { Write-Host \"`n✓ All build files are present!\" -ForegroundColor Green }"

author: Peerhop
